note: Edit this file to sell ad spots. Each ad: name, text, url (https only), optional cta, and "sample": true to label it as a demo (delete sample ads when real sponsors sign). An empty slot shows 'Your business here'. Optional Google AdSense for the news feed once approved: set adsense to {"client": "ca-pub-1234567890", "slot": "1234567890"}.
